name: Biogen Inc.
summary: Biogen Inc. discovers, develops, manufactures, and delivers therapies in the United States, Europe, Germany, Asia, and internationally. The company provides TECFIDERA, VUMERITY, AVONEX, PLEGRIDY, and TYSABRI for multiple sclerosis (MS); SPINRAZA for spinal muscular atrophy; SKYCLARYS to treat Friedreich's Ataxia; QALSODY for treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; FUMADERM to treat plaque psoriasi
style_reason: weder klarer Wachstums- noch klarer Value-Wert
verdict: Einstufung: Standardwert (gemischt) – weder klarer Wachstums- noch klarer Value-Wert. Buffett-Score 39/100 (Eher nicht), Innovations-Score 44/100 (Beobachten). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 192.24 USD (−27 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Mittel.
